September 29, 2026


We're looking forward to reconnecting with communities across the Athabasca Basin as this year's Community Tour gets underway next week. Join representatives from Cameco,[Orano](https://facebook.com/35158880592) ,[Ya'thi Néné Lands and Resources](https://facebook.com/136821083427192) and[Athabasca Denesuline Education Authority](https://facebook.com/103884791261715) for updates on community programs, operational activities, Collaboration Agreement progress, student awards and more. See the dates below and check the poster for details on your community stop. Everyone is welcome and we hope to see you there! October 5 – Fond du Lac October 6 – Uranium City October 7 – Stony Rapids and Black Lake October 8 – Hatchet Lake/Wollaston Lake
